activities.description: The University of Iowa logo is displayed.

The video shows a picture of a galaxy in a software called 'Maxim.' A cursor moves across the picture and a white line is drawn over it. Finally, a white triangle is drawn with a corner in the galaxy's center.
The video fades to black and a mathematical equation appears, which is the formula to calculate the distance between two points (Pythagorean theorem).
